name: all_st_mincuts (enumerate every minimum (s,t) edge cut of a directed graph)

benchmarks.note: directed path 0->1->...->n; value 1, exactly n minimum cuts (one per edge). Cost dominated by the max-flow + residual contraction/relabel pipeline, which grows super-linearly in n
k vertex-disjoint length-2 paths 0->mid_i->t; value k, 2^k minimum cuts (16/64/256). k kept tiny; exercises the Provan-Shier enumeration over a wide flat residual (~4x per step)
